title: Recording, radio and television exposure
summary: McCulley notes the growth of media; Armstrong notes there was no radio when he left New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts
story.community_name: Working radio and television: network shows, studio staffs, talk-show bands

blocks.x: It's been an interesting thing with your career, Louis, that the time that you have become, as I started as a boy, the whole industry, the recording industry has grown. Television has come in, motion pictures. Actually, this has given you a great exposure all over the world now.
Sure. And the first radio when it first started. When I left New Orleans, there was no radio.
